newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Body Shop sees slow U.S. recovery.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Body Shop sees slow U.S. recovery.

text.p: Body Shop International Plc, the beauty products retailer, said on Thursday improvement at its loss-making U.S. division would be slow and gradual, but sales were picking up.
Chairman Gordon Roddick, co-founder of the eco-friendly retailing chain with wife Anita, said the trend in the U.S. was gradually getting better.

"I think what we have is a long slow gradual improvement," he told Reuters in a telephone interview. "I think we are maintaining our competitive edge against our other competitors, whose like-for-like (sales) rate has considerably slowed."
